scope: True cold p0=0; one-dimensional planar, cylindrical-radial and spherical-radial finite volumes. No Cartesian 2D/3D calculation. The original base acceptance is unchanged; separately frozen spherical diagnostics are additive.

noh-shock.origin: reflecting parity; cylindrical and spherical origin faces have zero area
noh-shock.outer_boundary: time-dependent analytic cold inflow evaluated at boundary face
noh-shock.geometric_source: interfacial Rusanov normal stress F_mom-u_face*F_mass, with geometric stress integral selected explicitly by stress_quadrature_by_geometry
noh-shock.spatial_claim: 1D planar, 1D cylindrical-radial and 1D spherical-radial symmetry only; no Cartesian 2D/3D Euler calculation
